researchNotes: Range from the official collection pages (Classic Gold, Luna, Vulcani) and the Parfumerie Nasreen Tiziana Terenzi listing (retailer, first page of 23 items; the page text was truncated, so the range is incomplete). Official product pages on terenziboutique.com redirect to terenziboutique.us, where the product URLs I tried returned 404, so no official notes were obtained; all notes are reported from the Parfumerie Nasreen listing. Concentration, year, perfumer and family were not stated on any fetched page, so they are null. Items without notes in the sources are listed with official source only.

fragrances.name: Draconis
fragrances.performanceEvidence: FragranceX: stays on skin 8 to 12 hours; no retailer figure for sillage.

fragrances.name: Bianco Puro

sources.name: My Perfume Shop AU — Luna Collection Bianco Puro Extrait

fragrances.performanceEvidence: FragranceX: up to 12 hours on skin; My Perfume Shop AU: lasts approximately 8 hours. No reliable sillage figure.

fragrances.name: Cas
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Perfumista listing: longevity 6-12 hours, projection 60 cm to 2 m, recommended for daytime in spring and autumn.

fragrances.name: Chiron

sources.name: Scents Angel — Tiziana Terenzi Chiron Extrait

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scents Angel: 10-12+ hours, strong sillage, fall/winter evenings; Fragranxe: 8-10 hours, strong first two hours then moderate, cool seasons; MaxAroma: fall-winter.

fragrances.name: Mirach

sources.name: My Perfume Shop AU — Luna Star Mirach

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes review: heady projection and sillage, all-day duration; FragranceX: 8-10 hours, best fall/winter and evenings; My Perfume Shop AU: up to 8 hours.

fragrances.name: Hyakutake

sources.name: My Perfume Shop AU — Comet Collection Hyakutake

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Perfume.com: up to 12 hours, best in fall/winter, evening wear; My Perfume Shop AU: about 12 hours; FragranceX: at least 4, possibly 6+ hours. No sillage figure.

fragrances.name: Kaff
fragrances.performanceEvidence: FragranceX: lasts 8-10 hours, suited to fall/winter and evening; Perfume.com: 10-14 hours with powerful sillage, fall/winter; Venba: full day, moderate to strong sillage early.

fragrances.name: Laudano Nero

sources.name: Basenotes — Laudano Nero by Tiziana Terenzi
The Last Spritz — Tiziana Terenzi Laudano Nero

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes reviewer: beast performer, projection for hours (another reviewer calls performance ephemeral); The Last Spritz: 8-10 hours, strong trail, fall/winter at night; FragranceX: 6-8 hours, reviewer says perfect for cold weather.

fragrances.name: Siené
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Perfumista listing: longevity 6-12 hours, projection 60 cm to 2 m, suited to evening parties and meetings.

fragrances.name: Ecstasy

sources.name: Scent Grail — Tiziana Terenzi Ecstasy Review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scent Grail review: 8-10 hours with moderate projection, sillage low to medium, 4-6 sprays; best in spring, fall, winter. Basenotes reviewer: good longevity, nice vapor trail.

fragrances.name: Gold Rose Oudh

sources.name: Basenotes — Reviews of Gold Rose Oudh by Tiziana Terenzi
FragranceX — Tiziana Terenzi Gold Rose Oudh Perfume
Fragrance Review — Gold Rose Oudh by Tiziana Terenzi

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes reviewers: about 10h, 8-10h and ~12h with strong sillage/projection (one says ~4h, moderate); FragranceX buyer: 8h; Fragrance Review magazine: fall/winter, evening and night out.

fragrances.name: Spirito Fiorentino

sources.name: Basenotes — Spirito Fiorentino by Tiziana Terenzi

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes reviewers: a good 10+ hours of wear; another says it leaves a big scent trail and lasts all day.

fragrances.name: Kirké

sources.name: Decant Sample — Kirke Tiziana Terenzi guide

fragrances.performanceEvidence: FragranceX: lasts 3-5 hours per FAQ but reviewers call it beastly, lasting days on a jacket; spring/summer day wear; Decant Sample guide: strong sillage, 12+ hours, best in warm weather. Sources conflict on hours.

fragrances.name: Andromeda

sources.name: Beautinow — Tiziana Terenzi Andromeda Extrait de Parfum

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Beautinow listing: long-lasting, about 6-8h, moderate sillage and projection, ideal for spring/summer daytime.

fragrances.name: Cassiopea

sources.name: Beautinow — Tiziana Terenzi Cassiopea Extrait de Parfum
Scents Angel — Tiziana Terenzi Cassiopea Extrait de parfum

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Beautinow listing: long-lasting, about 6-8h, moderate sillage and projection, spring/summer daytime; Scents Angel listing: 8-10h, moderate sillage; a Blush Suede review found it shorter-lived and subtle.

fragrances.name: Draco

sources.name: My Perfume Shop — Tiziana Terenzi Luna Star Collection Draco Extrait De Parfum

fragrances.performanceEvidence: FragranceX: lingers up to 10 hours on many people, best season fall; My Perfume Shop: lasts up to 12 hours; buyer reviews are mixed (some find it soft or short-lived). No source gives sillage.

fragrances.name: Ursa

sources.name: Makeup.store — Tiziana Terenzi Luna Collection Ursa Extrait De Parfum

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scents Angel listing: 10-12h, strong sillage, fall/winter, night outs; Basenotes reviewers split (very close to skin and not long-lasting vs loud for hours and lasts all day); Makeup.store buyers: above-average longevity, amazing to soft sillage.

fragrances.name: Orion

sources.name: Beautinow — Tiziana Terenzi Orion Extrait de Parfum
Scents Angel — Tiziana Terenzi Orion Extrait de parfum
Blu Blazer Guy — Tiziana Terenzi Orion

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Beautinow listing: 8-10h, sillage moderate to heavy, projection moderate, evening wear; Scents Angel: 10-12h, strong sillage, fall/winter; FragranceX: up to 8-10h; Blu Blazer Guy review: longevity, sillage, projection each 4/5.

fragrances.name: Lince

sources.name: Scents Angel — Tiziana Terenzi Lince Extrait de parfum
My Perfume Shop — Tiziana Terenzi Luna Collection Lince Extrait De Parfum

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scents Angel listing: 8-10h, moderate sillage, noticeable yet soft projection, daytime in spring/summer; My Perfume Shop and Perfume.com: roughly 6-8h.

fragrances.name: Libra
fragrances.performanceEvidence: Perfume Picks community scores: longevity 4/5, sillage 3/5
